meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 DuckDB、Polars、numpy 等引擎分析 CSV/Parquet/JSON:做分组、join、聚合、时间序列与清洗,需要时画图。它会先探测文件大小和可用内存,再决定在内存加载、流式处理还是远程就地查询。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 CSV、Parquet 或 JSON 数据,或需要分组、聚合等数据处理与画图时接管。

say.text: 帮我分析 data.csv,按城市分组统计订单金额。
say.note: 用 DuckDB 直接查询文件,并报告行数与耗时。

say.text: 算出这个 10GB parquet 的每日趋势,别全读进内存。
say.note: 超内存时走流式或让 DuckDB 落盘。

say.text: 画一下这批数据的分布图。
say.note: 会先读可视化参考并做视觉检查。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes CSV/Parquet/JSON data with DuckDB, Polars and numpy: group-by, joins, aggregation, time series and charts. It probes file size and free RAM first, then loads in memory, streams, or queries remotely in place.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze CSV, Parquet or JSON data, or need group-by, aggregation and plotting on a dataset.

say_en.text: Analyze data.csv and total order amounts grouped by city.
say_en.note: Runs a direct DuckDB file query, reporting rows and time.

say_en.text: Compute the daily trend on this 10GB parquet without loading it all into memory.
say_en.note: Streams or lets DuckDB spill past RAM.

say_en.text: Plot the distribution of this dataset.
say_en.note: Reads the visualization reference and runs its visual check.
